defiParfait: Perfect! You know the basics of the unit circle.
defiBien: Good job. A quick go on the mini-lab and it will be perfect.
defiEncore: It's only the beginning: play with the mini-lab, then try again.
defiQ1E: At 0°, the point is at (1, 0): its x-coordinate, so cos 0°, is 1.
defiQ2E: At 90°, the point is at the top of the circle, at (0, 1): sin 90° = 1.
defiQ3E: A half turn is π radians: π rad = 180°.
defiQ4E: sin 30° = 1/2: one of the special values worth remembering.
defiQ5: On the unit circle, cos θ is…
defiQ5E: cos θ is read on the horizontal axis: it is the x-coordinate of point M.
